adjudication.rationale: In the newly added API route `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, the handler calls `appCredentialWebhookRequestBodySchema.parse(req.body)` without a try/catch. `zod.parse` throws on malformed input, which will bubble up as an unhandled error and return a 500. Likewise, `JSON.parse(symmetricDecrypt(reqBody.keys, process.env.CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY || ""))` can throw if the env key is missing/incorrect or if the ciphertext is corrupted/invalid JSON; this is also unhandled and will result in 500s instead of a controlled 4xx response. This is directly verifiable from the diff.
